title: Agent Forge Spec
description: Canonical declaration of a self-contained agent: harness/runtime config, system prompt, skills, MCP servers, plugins, trigger, and guardrails. Versioned via spec_version.

name.description: Kebab-case agent slug. Used for file names, receipt defaults, and scheduler labels.

description.description: One-line human summary of the agent.

purpose.description: What the agent is for, in operator language. Adapters render this prominently into the system prompt.

system_prompt.description: The agent's standing instructions. Inline Markdown or a file reference relative to the spec.

skills.description: On-demand procedures packaged as SKILL.md directories.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers the agent may use. Stdio servers declare command/args/env; remote servers declare url.

plugins.description: Runtime-specific extras, hinted with the runtimes they apply to. Freeform config; adapters ignore plugins not hinted for them.

model.description: Model identifier in the target runtime's native form (e.g. provider/model).

runtimes.description: Runtimes this spec targets. Each listed runtime must have an installed adapter at generation time.

schedule.description: 5-field cron expression. Required when type is cron.

trigger.description: How the agent is started. cron requires schedule.

guardrails.description: Safety contract every adapter must emit enforcement for. Omitted fields take the safe defaults documented in docs/spec-v1.md.

allowed_tools.description: Tool names the agent may invoke at all (exact, or prefix when ending in '/'). Default: all tools allowed. For LangGraph adapters, list the MCP tool names the agent needs (e.g. read_file).

allowed_side_effects.description: Side-effect action names the agent may perform (e.g. 'send-message', 'write-file:inbox/'). Default: none.

stop_file.description: Path whose existence pauses the agent. Default: <name>.stop.

path.description: Where the run receipt is written. Default: receipts/last.json.

llm_optional.description: When true, a run with nothing to do must complete without invoking the model. Default: true.

max_actions.description: Cap on side-effecting actions per run. Default: 3.
